```yaml
name: Benchmark v2

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g., 16912_4)'
        required: true
        type: string
      agent:
        description: 'Agent or provider'
        required: false
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model'
        required: false
        type: string
      timeout_seconds:
        description: 'Timeout in seconds (default 3600)'
        required: false
        default: 3600
        type: number
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'V2 setup wait time in seconds (default 900)'
        required: false
        default: 900
        type: number

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    concurrency:
      group: 'ts-bench-v2'

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository with LFS
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        lfs: true

    - name: Create patches directory
      run: mkdir -p .patches

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bun install

    - name: Pull Docker image
      run: docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1

    - name: Clean up disk space
      run: sudo apt-get clean && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    - name: Set environment variables
      env:
        TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC: ${{ github.event.inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}
      run: echo "TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC=${{ github.event.inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Run benchmark
      run: bun src/index.ts --dataset v2 --docker --exercise ${{ github.event.inputs.exercise }}

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: benchmark-results
        path: |
          data/results/
          results/
          logs/
          benchmark-summary.txt
          .patches/
```
